Academic Program Associate


About Us

Our company is an established education provider with presence in the United States, Brazil, and the Netherlands with global operations. We deliver comprehensive educational programs directly to students while also collaborating with institutional partners to broaden our reach and impact. As we continue our growth trajectory and enhance our operational capabilities, we're seeking passionate professionals who share our commitment to learner success and will help us build innovative, technology-enabled education solutions.


Job Overview

In this role, you will support the Partner School Academic Program Coordinator with day-to-day academic and operational tasks across our partner schools. You’ll handle scheduling, communications, documentation, data tracking, and logistics so that programs are implemented smoothly and aligned with WorldEd’s academic standards. As part of the Academic team, you’ll help maintain strong partnerships with schools, teachers, students, and families, contributing to high-quality program delivery and learner success.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate calendars, meetings, and school visits;
    prepare agendas, notes,and follow-ups for partner interactions.
  • Assist with the onboarding of new students and programs, ensuring required forms, access, and orientation steps are completed.
  • Maintain accurate records of school performance, teacher training, and student progress.
  • Draft and send routine communications to partner schools;
    escalate issues promptly to the Coordinator.
  • Support the integration of WorldEd curriculum/resources at partner schools, including basic troubleshooting.
  • Assist with logistics for teacher professional development (webinars, workshops), including invites and attendance tracking.
  • Organize and facilitate online and in-person training sessions for educators and staff.
  • Monitor routine academic indicators (attendance, assignment completion, grade pulls) and prepare summary reports.
  • Willingness and ability to travel within Brazil on a regular basis and work occasional evenings/weekends for school events.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years in K-12 and 1+ years in school coordination, school operations, customer success, or administrative support;
    education/EdTech experience preferred.
  • Strong organization and project coordination skills;
    able to manage multiplepriorities across schools.
  • Ability to develop, deliver, and adapt academic training content.
  • Clear written and verbal communication;
    fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus).
  • Savvy with instructional technology and online learning platforms;
    quick to learn new systems.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and service-minded;
    able to flag risks early and follow through on actions.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (Education or related field).
  • Commitment to WorldEd’s mission and to working in diverse school environments.


What We Offer

  • A culture in a constantly growing segment with continuous learning opportunities.
  • Full scholarship for direct dependents in WorldEd's International programs.
  • Total Pass wellness and quality of life benefit.
  • Hybrid work model:
    3+ days on-site in São Paulo (Zona Sul);
    availability for nationwide travel (evenings/weekends as needed).
  • Parking at our headquarters.
  • Compensation plan consisting of a fixed monthly amount + bonus tied to goals, under a contract model (PJ legal entity).


If you’re passionate about learner success, thrive on organization and clear communication, and want to grow in international K-12 education, we’d love to hear from you!

Se você gosta de pensar diferente, colaborar e fazer parte de algo grande, chegue mais. Somos uma das maiores Logitechs do Brasil e ainda estamos só começando.


O Desafio:

Buscamos um Engenheiro de Dados para garantir a disponibilidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados da empresa, estruturando pipelines e arquiteturas que suportem análises avançadas e soluções de inteligência artificial. O que esperamos de você:

Sua atuação será focada em:

title: Medical Science Liaison - Brazil
description:
Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company with global Headquarters based in San Diego, California developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world’s premier fully-integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.


Position Summary:

Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be in Brazil.


MSL is a field-based scientific expert focused on developing and maintaining peer-to-peer relationships with key medical experts and healthcare professionals. This role will primarily support the company Acromegaly program. The MSL will collaborate with physicians and other medical experts to support trial enrollment, provide programming and protocol training and ensure that health care professionals have the most up to date information as the clinical development programs mature and conduit for external scientific engagement and internal strategic alignment, contributing to evidence generation, medical education, and cross-functional support. The MSL supports the generation of scientific knowledge through facilitation of investigator-initiated trials and publications.


Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

These may include but are not limited to:


  • Develop and maintain peer-to-peer collaborations and relationships with KOLs community
  • Provide scientific support for pre-launch initiatives, including medical congresses, advisory boards, and educational events.
  • Tactical delivery of programs according to established objectives and serves as a resource for education and dissemination of pertinent, clear, and balanced medical-scientific information to internal audiences (Marketing, Medical Affairs, Research & Development and Sales) and external audiences (healthcare professionals, consumers, patient organizations, distributors, etc.)
  • Support clinical development initiatives including site identification, trial recruitment, registry, and presentation of final approved data
  • Collaborating with physicians on medical affairs initiatives including publications, advisory boards, medical education opportunities, training, and speaker development
  • Serve as scientific peer-to-peer resource to external disease experts and internal stakeholders
  • Support the medical community with up-to-date medical information, robust disease expertise, and product information
  • Communicate clinical insights on new data to the company Medical Affairs and to inform medical strategy for the therapeutic area
  • Train internal stakeholders on key scientific and medical topics in relevant therapeutic areas.
  • Develop an understanding of the regional landscape including specialties involved in care of patients -
  • Maintain effective and appropriate communication among internal stakeholders while maintaining full compliance with relevant requirements
  • Generate tactical regional plans to provide needs based, value-added support of the medical and scientific community in-line with company goals
  • Uses systems to strategically map, identify, profile and prioritize thought leaders in line with the medical plan and goals
  • Maintain accurate reporting and documentation of MSL activities.


Education:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biology, pharmacy, or other medical related disciplines.
  • Advanced degree preferred.



Requirements:


  • 12 years of professional experience,
  • At least 5 years of experience in Medical Affairs or Medical Science roles.
  • Robust and current clinical development experience supporting drugs to treat rare diseases;
    prior endocrinology diseases experience, preferred.
  • MSL and/or strong scientific experience in endocrinology, and specifically growth hormone-related disorders, preferred.
  • Pre-launch experience is highly preferred.
  • Excellent written, oral, communication, leadership and organizational skills.
  • Solid interpersonal and communication skills;
    demonstrated relationship builder. Ability to work well across teams to communicate relevant insights and drive strategy.
  • Candidates must understand compliance considerations and demonstrate ability to work compliantly in a field-based role, within the medical organization, as well as across the commercial organization.


Travel:

Up to 70%. Willingness to travel extensively across the region, including nights/weekends.

Acolhemos todas as candidaturas sem distinção de gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, origem étnica, religião, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica. title: Project Manager
description:
Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais:
Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam:
Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Objetivo da posição:

Apoiar a gestão ponta a ponta de projetos, aprendendo na prática e assumindo responsabilidades progressivas, com acompanhamento próximo do time de coordenadores e PMs experientes.


Principais responsabilidades:

- Planejar e acompanhar projetos junto à equipe técnica (escopo, cronograma, custo, riscos e qualidade).

- Colher, organizar e apresentar informações de status report, atas de reunião e indicadores de projeto.

- Mapear necessidades dos clientes internos e traduzi-las em ações práticas.

- Garantir que a comunicação flua entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.

- Engajar times multidisciplinares e fornecedores, garantindo clareza na compreensão de papeis e responsabilidades.

- Garantir follow-up e disciplina de execução junto aos times.

- Organizar e gerenciar processos relacionados aos testes de usuários.

- Organizar o processo de transferência de conhecimento para as equipes de sustentação.

- Participar de processos de pré-projeto (RFPs, orçamentos, equalizações).


Requisitos desejados:

- Formação superior completa ou em andamento (Administração, TI, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas).

- Inglês avançado.

- Conhecimento em metodologias de projetos (PMI, Agile, Scrum ou similares).

- Boa capacidade de organização, raciocínio lógico, comunicação clara e objetividade.

- Perfil de autogestão, proatividade, resiliência e vontade de aprender.

- Vivência anterior em projetos SAP ou de tecnologia.


Diferenciais:

- Certificações iniciais (Scrum Fundamentals, CAPM, etc.).

title: Gerente Financeiro
description:
Descrição da vaga:


  • Gerir as atividades administrativas e financeiras do shopping, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação, normas e procedimentos internos, por meio de controle orçamentário eficaz e redução dos custos condominiais.
  • Garantir a cobrança de inadimplentes, promovendo a saúde financeira do empreendimento.
  • Conduzir a gestão comercial das lojas ativas, focando na diminuição da vacância e na diversificação do mix de operações saudáveis e adimplentes, com o objetivo de manter os custos condominiais reduzidos para os locatários e maximizar a rentabilidade dos investidores.
  • Desenvolver estratégias para otimizar custos e melhorar a eficiência financeira.


Responsabilidades e Atividades:


  • Planejamento e Controle Orçamentário:
    Garantir o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas no orçamento anual do CPI, Condomínio e FPP, monitorando todas as linhas de resultados esperados e implementando ações corretivas para eventuais desvios.
  • Gestão de Contas a Receber:
    Assegurar o recebimento dos valores faturados, acompanhando as cobranças e inadimplências. Supervisionar a transferência de inadimplências para o escritório jurídico e monitorar os resultados, visando a recuperação financeira e a melhoria dos resultados. Garantir o Cumprimento da régua de cobrança.
  • Gestão de Contas a Pagar:
    Garantir o pagamento pontual das obrigações assumidas, tanto com fornecedores quanto com o fisco, assegurando o controle dos gastos e a identificação de possíveis distorções no orçamento aprovado.
  • Gestão da Auditoria de Lojas:
    Supervisionar a auditoria das lojas do shopping, garantindo que as informações sobre o desempenho de vendas estejam corretas, com o objetivo de assegurar o cumprimento dos contratos e maximizar a receita proveniente do aluguel percentual.
  • Análise Financeira:
    Realizar análises detalhadas do desempenho financeiro, incluindo fluxo de caixa, demonstrações de resultados e balanços patrimoniais, identificando oportunidades de crescimento e melhoria financeira.
  • Gestão do Fluxo de Caixa:
    Monitorar diariamente o fluxo de caixa para assegurar liquidez adequada para as operações e o cumprimento das metas orçamentárias.
  • Controle de Custos:
    Desenvolver estratégias para reduzir custos operacionais, garantindo a eficiência dos serviços e o equilíbrio financeiro do empreendimento sem comprometer a qualidade.
  • Relatórios Financeiros:
    Preparar e revisar relatórios financeiros periódicos para a alta administração, fornecendo insights estratégicos e propondo melhorias para otimizar os resultados financeiros.
  • Gestão de Riscos:
    Identificar e mitigar riscos financeiros relacionados à conformidade com legislações e regulamentos, além de proteger a empresa de possíveis perdas financeiras.
  • Relacionamento com Parceiros:
    Gerenciar as relações financeiras com lojas âncoras, fornecedores e prestadores de serviços, assegurando a negociação de contratos vantajosos e o cumprimento dos acordos financeiros.
  • Elaboração de Orçamento:
    Desenvolver e revisar o orçamento anual com previsões detalhadas de receitas e despesas, alinhadas às metas estratégicas do shopping.
  • Monitoramento de Transações Financeiras :
    Acompanhar as transações financeiras diárias, garantindo precisão, conformidade e execução dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Auditorias e Conformidade:
    Coordenar auditorias internas e externas, garantindo que todas as práticas financeiras estejam de acordo com normas internas e regulamentos legais.
  • Cumprimento das Políticas Financeiras:
    Garantir que todas as atividades financeiras estejam em conformidade com as políticas internas, assegurando a eficiência, transparência e boas práticas administrativas.
  • Suporte ao RH:
    Colaborar com a área de recursos humanos em questões relacionadas à gestão de equipes e conformidade com a legislação trabalhista, visando evitar penalidades e promover boas práticas de gestão de pessoas.


Requisitos de Qualificação Mínima:


  • Superior Completo - Administração de Empresas e cursos equivalentes, Ciências Contábeis e Economia.
  • Desejável:
    Especialização/Pós-Graduação – Gestão Financeira, Econômica e/ou Contábil.
  • Competências Técnicas Conhecimento em Finanças e Contabilidade:
    Compreensão profunda de princípios financeiros, contábeis e fiscais, incluindo elaboração de balanços patrimoniais, demonstrações de resultados e análises de fluxo de caixa.
  • Planejamento e Análise Financeira:
    Habilidade em elaborar e monitorar orçamentos, realizar previsões financeiras e análises de variações.
  • Gestão de Fluxo de Caixa:
    Capacidade para gerenciar o fluxo de caixa, otimizar a liquidez e garantir a cobertura das despesas operacionais e investimentos.
  • Conhecimento em Sistemas de Informação Financeira:
    Proficiência em software de contabilidade e ferramentas de análise financeira, como ERP e planilhas avançadas.
  • Gestão de Risco e Compliance:
    Habilidade em identificar, avaliar e mitigar riscos financeiros, e garantir a conformidade com regulamentos e normas.
  • Análise de Investimentos:
    Capacidade para avaliar e planejar investimentos e expansões, realizando análises de viabilidade e retorno sobre investimento.

title: District Commercial Manager
description:
1. About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief:
"We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!


2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment :
    Assist Keeta in establishing a food delivery sales team in new cities, starting from scratch to drive business expansion. Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.
  • System Development and Optimization :
    Establish and maintain smooth communication channels within and outside the team. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building :
    Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment :
    Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking :
    Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review :
    Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization :
    Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.


3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience :
    Has experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in another company over the past year.
  • Team Leadership Methods :
    Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing :
    Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking :
    Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development :
    Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience :
    Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency :
    Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work and travel.


4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

Our journey started in 1973 with a single store in Bahrain. Since then, we have grown into a global retail and hospitality group. The proud creator of 25 plus value led, own-built brands across retail, hospitality, food, and leisure.

From Max, Splash, Babyshop, Centrepoint, Shoemart, Home Centre, Emax, Fitness First, to Fun City, to name a few, our brands span across a multitude of categories, enriching the lives of countless families over the past decade.


As a part of the Landmark Group, a renowned retail and hospitality conglomerate in the Middle East, North Africa, and India, Landmark Digital is the dynamic digital arm of Landmark Retail, serving as the cornerstone of our omnichannel business strategy.


Headquartered in Dubai, UAE, we oversee the digital operations of eight leading brands across diverse geographies, with ambitious plans for expansion into new territories and functions. Joining us means becoming a vital part of the Middle East's most significant bricks-to-clicks success story, boasting an impressive year-on-year growth rate exceeding 100%.


Comprising a talented workforce of over 700 professionals across diverse domains, Landmark Digital spearheads various functions including Enterprise and E-commerce Tech, Product Management, User Design, and MarTech, among others. With our futuristic outlook, we are committed to delivering seamless digital experiences to our customers.


Landmark Digital

Additionally, our dedicated software development center in Bangalore, India, offers opportunities for incubation, design, and optimization of digital products.


Working at Landmark Digital means engaging with cutting-edge technologies , including Enterprise and E-commerce tech, headless commerce, Java Spring Boot, React Native, React frontend, and Azure Cloud solutions, providing an enriching environment for professional growth and development.


In addition to competitive remuneration and benefits , we prioritize continuous learning and growth through dedicated training and upskilling initiatives. title: Monitoring Specialist
description:
About Playtech

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience.

As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here:
and />
Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.


Ready to level up your career?

Playtech Managed Services Sao Paulo is looking for a proactive Monitoring Specialist with excellent communication, attention to detail, reaction time and problem-solving skills.

Job Description

Your influential mission. You will...

  • Perform Monitoring, Incident Management, Redundancy and Incident Reporting activities.
  • Work on shifts (16/7 coverage ).
  • Monitor multiple business systems and detect incidents across multiple service dependencies.
  • React by executing appropriate redundancy protocols based on service type.
  • Coordinate incident communication with multiple parties.
  • Familiarize yourself with Incident Management documentation.
  • Learn the company products at a technical and operational level, including backend settings, integrations and monitoring dashboards.
  • Liase with third parties during Incident Management.
  • Understand how the environments and available configurations work.
  • Acquire insight into Incident Management processes in a global company.
  • Communicate daily with other teams in and outside the company.
  • Constantly develop skills and get new knowledge in the Incident Management domain.
  • Carry out investigations to determine Incident root causes.
Qualifications

Components for success. You...

  • Are willing to develop your career in Incident Management.
  • You have previous experience in Monitoring, Incident Management or a similar role (1 year minimum, 2 or more years recommended).
  • Possess knowledge of Monitoring and Incident Reporting methodologies and processes.
  • Have good written and verbal communication skills in English and you can communicate with team members, clients, and stakeholders in English.

You'll get extra points for...

  • Having experience working with Grafana or similar tools
Additional Information

Thrive in a culture that values...

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A commitment to innovation and excellence.
  • A diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is welcome.
  • Comprehensive benefits and competitive compensation.

HOW TO APPLY?

In addition to your CV, please add a brief motivation letter covering your goals, your current experience in Monitoring or related fields, and/or working in a corporate environment. You can write it in the comment section at the end of the application page (under "your message to the hiring manager").

MONITORING TEAM

The Monitoring Team is a crucial part of the Incident Report Operational Center (IROC). The team is dedicated to centralizing incident monitoring, detection, and initial response across all relevant systems. Our mission is to ensure business continuity and protect customer experience by proactively managing incidents. The team monitors all business systems, detects incidents across multiple service dependencies, and reacts by executing appropriate redundancy protocols based on service type. We manage incident communication and documentation across all service types and criticality levels.

Our team operates 16/7, ensuring immediate response and detailed incident reporting, documenting all actions and outcomes for transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in incident management.

Join the team at our new Brazilian Playtech Managed Services (PTMS) office, where we work together to support and enhance our live products and services. Be part of a global, dynamic and innovative team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and excellence.

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

title: Software Engineer, Qa, Brazil - X Delivery
description:
Locations :
São Paulo | Rio de Janeiro

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.


We Are BCG X

We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.


What You'll Do

As a Software Developer in Test at BCG X, you will play a pivotal role in improving our software development lifecycle, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, robust software solutions. Assignments will range from short term Proof of Concepts/Minimum Viable Products to long term cases.

  • As a member of BCG’s X Delivery team, you will work with consulting teams on a diverse range of sophisticated topics
  • You will have the opportunity to leverage software development methodologies to deliver value to BCG's Consulting & BCG X (case) teams, BCG X Product teams and Practice Areas (domain) through the delivery of specialized knowledge in software development, and accelerated execution support
  • Collaborate with teams to gather requirements, specify, design, develop, deliver and support software solutions serving client needs
  • Provide technical support through deep understanding of relevant tools and processes to build high quality and efficient technology solutions
  • Work closely with development and product teams to identify and mitigate risks before software release
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts to validate software functionalities, performance, and reliability
  • Implement continuous integration (CI) and continuous deployment (CD) processes to streamline testing and deployment phases
  • Collaborate on software design reviews to ensure testability and best practices are incorporated early in the development process
  • Analyze test results, identify issues, and work with development teams to resolve them promptly
  • Stay abreast of the latest testing technologies and methodologies to continuously improve testing strategies and efficiency

What You'll Bring

Must-Have Technical Skills:
  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, JavaScript, and familiarity with Unix/Linux environments.
  • Proficiency with Git and CI/CD tools (e.G., CircleCI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks (e.G., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing tools (e.G., Postman).
  • Knowledge of relational databases (e.G., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and the ability to write and debug SQL queries.
Job Requirements:
  • Bachelor's / Master's in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English
  • Proven track record as a Software Developer in Test or similar role, focusing on automated testing in a dynamic development environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identify and resolve issue.
Quality Assurance Responsibilities:
  • Understand and implement best-fit approaches to testing, ensuring that applications and new features' work as expected.
  • Maintain knowledge base of manual and automated testing.
  • Create and execute reusable automated / manual test cases and translate business logic into project requirements.
  • Leverage technologies to support business needs to attain high reusability and maintainability of current and newly developed systems.
  • Understand available automation tools and how/when they should be used.
  • Write effective unit tests and integration tests to ensure high-quality software delivery.
  • In-depth understanding of Executing System and Regression Testing.
  • Awareness of performance testing tools in an Agile environment.
  • Work independently on quality / testing tasks with minimal direction.
Business requirement gathering and collaboration:
  • Establish credibility by thought partnering with highly demanding stakeholders / consulting teams on application development and delivery topics;
    drawing conclusions on a range of external and internal issues and dependencies.
  • Execute software testing approach and creating defined outcome;
    contributing to approach selection.
  • Assure proper sign‐off before uploading materials into internal repository for reference;
    sanitizing confidentialclient content in marketing documents.
  • Contribute to team’s content & IP development.

Additional info

Please apply for the positions equivalent to your previous work experiences. The seniority will be evaluated according to your experience and career structure at BCG X during the process. Even if you don’t meet all these requirements, we encourage you to apply if this job description excites you.

Note:
For this position, we are considering applicants from São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, including both the capital cities and the surrounding areas within a 150km radius of the capitals.

title: Supervisor de Contratos
description:
#### **Sobre a Vaga:**

Estamos em busca de um **Supervisor de Contratos** altamente qualificado e proativo para se juntar à nossa equipe. O profissional ideal terá uma sólida experiência em gestão de contratos, especialmente no setor público, e demonstrará um forte senso de liderança e responsabilidade.

Esta é uma oportunidade para quem gosta de desafios e busca atuar de forma direta e estratégica na gestão de contratos, garantindo a excelência na execução e o alinhamento com os objetivos da empresa. Se você tem visão de dono, é comprometido e possui expertise em medições e faturamento, queremos conhecer você!

#### **Principais Responsabilidades:**

* Gerenciar e fiscalizar a execução de contratos, com foco principal em contratos do setor público.
* Coordenar e validar as medições dos serviços prestados, garantindo a precisão e a conformidade com o escopo contratado.
* Liderar o processo de faturamento, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos e das exigências documentais.
* Atuar diretamente em campo, realizando visitas técnicas e auditorias para garantir a qualidade e o andamento dos serviços (trabalho externo).
* Liderar equipes, distribuindo tarefas, orientando e desenvolvendo os colaboradores para alcançar as metas estabelecidas.
* Realizar a interface entre a empresa, os clientes e os órgãos públicos, solucionando pendências e garantindo um relacionamento transparente e eficaz.
* Identificar riscos e oportunidades nos contratos, propondo melhorias e otimizações nos processos.

#### **Requisitos e Qualificações:**

* **Experiência comprovada** em gestão, medição e faturamento de contratos, preferencialmente com clientes do setor público.
* Habilidade de liderança para gerir e motivar equipes em campo.
* **Comprometimento** com prazos, metas e a qualidade das entregas.
* **Visão de dono:** proatividade para identificar problemas e agir na solução, buscando sempre o melhor resultado para o negócio.
* Excelente capacidade de organização, planejamento e comunicação.
* Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial e atuação externa, diretamente nos locais dos contratos.
* Formação superior em (Sugerir áreas como: Engenharia, Administração, Direito ou áreas correlatas).

#### **O que oferecemos:**

* Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma empresa em crescimento.
* Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e desafiador.
* **Salário a combinar** (estamos abertos a propostas alinhadas à sua experiência).

Acompanhar tendências do mercado e concorrência para garantir competitividade. Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de engenharia e suprimentos para garantir a viabilidade comercial dos projetos. Assegurar o cumprimento das metas de faturamento e rentabilidade da empresa. Representar a empresa em eventos, feiras e reuniões estratégicas do setor. Gerenciar indicadores de desempenho comercial e elaborar relatórios estratégicos para a diretoria.

Conhecimento de normas do setor elétrico e experiência com leilões e contratos com empresas da área de energia. Experiência mínima de 5 anos comprovada na área comercial, no setor de energia, construção de subestações, linhas de transmissão e distribuição e redes de média tensão. Capacidade de liderança, visão estratégica e foco em resultados. Disponibilidade para viagens e participação em eventos do setor. Possuir CNH.

title: Freelancer - Consultor Externo - Consultoria Estrangeiros
description:
Abaixo alguns serviços que o consultor externo prestará para a empresa caso tenha interesse:

Orientation Tour: apresentar a cidade para o cliente pontuando os melhores bairros para se morar, melhores restaurantes, shoppings, mercados, pontos turísticos e as melhores escolas. Esse atendimento costuma ser de 6 a 8 horas, muitas vezes marcamos alguns modelos de imóveis para que o cliente veja o padrão (quando recebemos o perfil do cliente já passamos para ele um breve resumo da cidade).
(Atendimento de 6 - 8 horas valor pago por hora R$50,00)

House Hunting: acompanhar o cliente em visitas a imóveis, a agenda do cliente somos nós do escritório que preparamos muitas vezes nossos clientes não fala português o consultor será o intérprete para esclarecer dúvidas que os clientes têm em relação aos imóveis.
(Atendimento de 6 - 8 horas valor pago por hora R$50,00)

Vistoria de Entrada: quando o cliente aluga um imóvel, o consultor vai até o apartamento para fazer uma vistoria de entrada. O consultor realiza, então, um relatório contendo um repasse minucioso no apartamento, destacando o estado atual de cada cômodo do imóvel em relação à pintura, desgaste do piso, estado das janelas, etc. Este relatório contém fotos.
(Valor do Pacote R$ 290,00 sem reembolso de despesas)
No valor do pacote são considerados 2 atendimentos: vistoria de entrada/ entrega das chaves.

Vistoria de Saída: realizar a comparação em relação à vistoria de entrada e verificar se existe a necessidade de reparos, levando em consideração o desgaste natural devido ao uso.
(Valor do Pacote R$ 340,00 sem reembolso de despesas)
No valor do pacote são considerados 3 atendimentos: repasse de vistoria/ verificação dos reparos acordados/ entrega de chaves para o proprietário.

Imigração: Acompanhar o cliente na Polícia Federal, Consulado, Poupa Tempo/Ganha Tempo e Detran para esclarecer as possíveis dúvidas do cliente referentes a procedimentos ou documentações em geral.
(Cada atendimento tem um valor específico fornecido durante o agendamento com o consultor. Este valor varia conforme o órgão a ser visitado).

Certificação Conhecimento

Alguns dos pré-requisitos necessários para cadastro do CV:

Pessoa jurídica (possuir CNPJ)
Boa comunicação interpessoal
Flexibilidade de horário
Possuir carro

Somos uma consultoria com foco na transferência de estrangeiros e executivos ao Brasil, dando suporte à parte burocrática quanto à documentação e residência, busca de acomodação e escola, orientação quanto à cidade, e assistência mensal aos estrangeiros, quando necessário.

Trata-se de um trabalho esporádico e não fixo, de acordo com a demanda de cada cidade.

Os atendimentos são todos realizados através do escritório. As coordenadoras entram em contato para estabelecer os horários a serem agendados e esclarecer possíveis dúvidas.
